name: header-integrity
description: Response-header and versioning correctness checks the suite never asserted before: ETag digest grammar (MI-004/MI-027), manifest Content-Type (MI-006/MI-007), first manifestVersion=1 (MI-026), and client ID URL-safety (MI-002/MI-020). All target behavior confirmed present in the real Symphony implementation (device-agent-vendor.go / device.go) — kept isolated in its own group so a wrong assumption about exact header formatting fails here, not in core/silver.
